name: Thistlefuzz Arcanery
summary: East of the Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery draws enchanters and scholars. Gnome practitioners run this prominent workshop and academy, a haven for those who weave magic into metal and parchment. Its chambers hum with arcane energy beside the fires of dwarven industry.

sections.title: Arcane Craft in the Mountain
sections.body: East of the Great Forge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery contrasts with the clanging anvils of dwarven smiths. Across its two levels, scholars, practitioners, and apprentices gather to study enchanting and the arcane arts. Dwarves reshape steel with muscle and fire; the gnomes here show how raw arcane energy can be bound into weapons, armor, and curious tools. For spellcasters making their way through the mountain stronghold, the Arcanery remains an essential sanctuary.

faq.answer: Thistlefuzz Arcanery sits along the eastern ring of the Great Forge in central Ironforge. Arcane apparatuses and enchanting supplies displayed around its doors mark the way.

faq.q: What services are offered inside the Arcanery?
faq.answer: The Arcanery gathers enchanting trainers, spellcraft suppliers, and scholars to teach apprentices, trade rare reagents, and conduct experiments away from the smithies' physical soot.

faq.q: Why is an arcane workshop situated so close to the Great Forge?
aliases: why is it near the forge
faq.answer: The Arcanery's position beside the Great Forge is practical. Newly forged blades, armor plates, and mechanical components can be carried east at once to receive protective enchantments and elemental power.

angles.text: For gnomes residing in Ironforge, Thistlefuzz Arcanery is a comfortable reminder of their love for arcane theory, technical study, and delicate experimentation amid a city dominated by heavy dwarven iron.
For visiting mages, the Arcanery offers familiar reagents, quiet corners for theory, and kindred spellcasters among the otherwise martial, weapon-focused halls of the dwarf capital.
